data.name: HOLLYWOOD DIRECTOR THE SIMULATION
data.detailed_description:
Would you like to live the life of a famous Hollywood director and create your own blockbuster movie? How about acting in your own Jurassic Park, Star Wars, Avengers or Terminator?

Now you can. Hollywood Director The Simulation® is the complete Hollywood movie production simulator.

SET DESIGN


• Start by selecting your ideal movie location from dozens of pre-built virtual sets such as apartments, offices, warehouses, bars, restaurants Wild West saloons space stations or cyberpunk cities

CUSTOM SETS


• Customise these sets by deleting or adding objects from hundreds of high-quality 3D models in the library
• Repaint every model using your own chosen colour, texture or material
• Build lanscapes with sprawling cities, canyons, deserts, flowing rivers, trees, bushes and fauna

CAMERA MOVEMENT


• Take complete control of the camera using Hollywood standard techniques such as pan, track, tilt, zoom and Steadicam
• Add camera effects such as camera shake and soft focus

LENSES AND ASPECT RATIOS


• Select the correct lenses for each shot such as Hollywood standard Cooke Prime lenses (12mm to 180mm)
• Choose the right aspect ratio for your blockbuster such as 4:3, 1.66:1, 16:9, 1.85:1, 2.39:1 or 2:75:1
• Select your aperture (F-Stop) settings from f1.4 to f/22.0

LIGHTING


• Choose from dozens of lighting prefabs suitable for any movie genre such as a romantic comedy, a superhero action adventure, a Wild West epic, a musical or a horror movie
• Create your own custom lighting prefab by tweaking the advanced lighting features such as intensity, fade off distance, gamma and colour

POST-PROCESSING EFFECTS


• Bring your scenes to life by adding effects such as bloom, chromatic aberration, lens distortion, motion blur and depth of field

CASTING


• Choose from hundreds of pre-built character models, male, female, transgender, demons, space marines or zombies
• Create your own custom actors by tweaking skin, eye colour, height, body shape and hair style
• Act in your own blockbuster by adding your face to the virtual actor from a single selfie

COSTUMES


• Choose your characters’ attire from hundreds of costume prefabs such as shoes, skirts, bikins, frocks, trousers, blouses, kimonos or saris

ANIMATIONS


• Get your virtual actors walking, jumping, somersaulting or flying like a superhero using the thousands of animations in the library

CHARACTER LIPSYNC
• Record your own audio and lipsync your characters

SURROUND SOUND
• Create a full surround soundscape by adding dozens of sound effects to each shot
• Add a sound effect to any object or animation
• Tweak the volume, pitch and reverb of each sound effect

VISUAL EFFECTS


• Bring your blockbuster to life by adding visual effects such as explosions, lasers or superhero-style magic spells
• Add dynamic physics-based effects such as destruction, fragmentation

WEATHER EFFECTS


• Captivate your audience using environmental effects such as fog, rain, snow, tsunamis and blizzards

TOON SHADING


• Turn your photoreal scenes into stylized 2D toon or anime-style ones

EDITING
• Render each shot of your movie in multiple resolutions for any format from mobile phones to IMAX screens
• Create Hollywood-style opening and closing title sequences

MODDING


• Create your own mods with customised sets, characters, lighting, audio and visual effects
• Share it with the community directly from within the game

data.short_description: Live the life of a famous Hollywood director. Add your face to the actors from a selfie. Create custom sets with lighting for a romance, Wild West, sci-fi, horror or fantasy adventure. Cast, animate the actors, add VFX like fog, rain, blizzards, lasers, tsunamis and magic spells. Add surround sound.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 75 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12 compatible
